title.en: Lines carrying their readings, on the course their acts generate
title.zh: 携其读法之系，于其行为所生之程

statement.en: A world whose relata act by the readings they carry is the course those acts generate; the line read off it is descended by construction and carries its founders' inherited reading; with ending read as an overdraw of that course, G3's realization premise is the identity.
statement.zh: 诸关系项依其所携读法而行之世界即此诸行为所生之程；读自其上之系由构造相传、携其始祖所传之读法；终读为此程之透支时，G3 之实现前提即为恒等。

laws.en: Each relatum exchanges as the act its reading gives. Where every member of a part carries one reading, the world is the rest acting by its readings and the part by that reading's act, by construction. Acts reading what has stood, or only what couples into their relatum, give a world that does too.
laws.zh: 各关系项依其读法所给之举交换。一部分之成员皆携同一读法处，此世界由构造即其余依其读法、此部分依该读法之举而行。读已成者、或只读耦合入其关系项者之举，所成之世界亦然。

laws.en: A balanced flow in which every formation exchanges as a law of what has stood gives, under the flow's own levels, has the levels the law generates at every step, and the law's course is feasible: balance gives the feasibility that the uniqueness of the generated course takes as a premise.
laws.zh: 一平衡之流中每一形成皆依一读已成者之律在流自身之水平下交换，则其水平每步即此律所生之水平，且此律之程可行：平衡给出所生之程之唯一性所取为前提之可行性。

laws.en: From founders and a listing of the relata, the line read off a flow takes as a member's offspring across a step the listed relata descending from it then. It is descended in the flow by construction, its later members stand, and where readings are inherited along descent every member of every cohort carries the founders' reading.
laws.zh: 由始祖与关系项之列，读自一流之系以一步中自某成员而传之所列关系项为其后裔。此系由构造即在流中相传，其后之成员皆立；读法沿传承而继处，每一代之每一成员皆携始祖之读法。

laws.en: Let a reading end where its world's course overdraws a family from a short stock. Where every occasion picks the reading the line carries and the world is the course it generates, G3's realization premise is the identity, ending being defined as that overdraw; under G3's remaining premises some strict order according with the choices puts every non-ending reading above every ending one met with it.
laws.zh: 设诸选项为读法，各给一世界；读法终者，其世界之程自短存而透支一族。每一场合皆择此系所携之读法、且世界即其所生之程处，G3 之实现前提即为恒等（终即定义为此透支）；在 G3 其余前提下，有一与诸择相合之严格序，置每一不终之读法于与之同遇之每一终者之上。

laws.en: A line is alive at a step where its cohort then has a member. It reaches a relatum before a step where a member of one of its cohorts, a member at that earlier step, exchanged with a condition the relatum then requires: reach before a step lifted to lines with membership dated, implying the time-blind form for every part holding the members, and lying within affecting.
laws.zh: 一系于某步有成员处为活。其某代之一成员、于先前一步为成员者，与一关系项此步所需之条件交换处，此系于此步前及之：步前之及提升至系、成员身份有时日，对含其成员之每一部分蕴含不计时之形，且在影响之内。

laws.en: In the witness every course is the one the acts generate, each relatum acts by the reading it carries, readings are inherited along descent and the line carries its reading; the line reaches the dweller's line before the second step by clearing its habitat; with nothing coming back the dweller's line reaches nothing, and in the course where it renews the source it reaches the line.
laws.zh: 见证中每一程皆行为所生之程，各关系项依其所携读法而行，读法沿传承而继，此系携其读法；此系以清其栖地于第二步前及于栖者之系；无所返时栖者之系无所及，于其续源之程则及于此系。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Discrete steps and natural levels; one kind of relatum, each a formation and a condition; a web, the relata present and the starting levels supplied.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。离散步与自然数水平；一种关系项，各为形成亦为条件；网、在场之关系项与起始水平为给定。

hypotheses.en: The act each reading gives is supplied, and so is which relata are listed and which founders start a line.
hypotheses.zh: 各读法所给之举为给定，所列之关系项与起一系之始祖亦然。

hypotheses.en: Inheritance of readings along descent is a premise of the law that a line carries its founders' reading; the witness proves it of its world.
hypotheses.zh: 读法沿传承而继，是系携其始祖读法之律之前提；见证于其世界证之。

does_not_show.en: That an act indexed by what a line carries reads it only within a closure: carrying the index gives nothing of how the act reads it, so ActReadsWithin stays a premise.
does_not_show.zh: 以系所携者为索引之举只在闭包内读之：携索引不给出举如何读之，故 ActReadsWithin 仍为前提。

does_not_show.en: That an ending pick is realized as an overdraw where occasions pick different readings: that needs a run made of the picks, not built here.
does_not_show.zh: 诸场合择不同读法处终止之择实现为透支：此需由诸择所成之一程，此处未建。

does_not_show.en: How a reading arises or changes: readings here are carried along descent, never varied or learned.
does_not_show.zh: 读法如何生或变：此处读法沿传承而携，从不变异或习得。

does_not_show.en: That reach before a step by a time-blind part gives a line's dated reach: the lift goes one way.
does_not_show.zh: 以不计时之部分于步前之及，给出系之有时日之及：提升只一向。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, axiom report empty; a leaf. Every law is near-definitional; the witness has finitely many relata, its courses' balance proved for all steps and shown to be the generated ones. Written by an AI; readers of two other models read the statements cold against this record and its home (READER in the study folder); no human audit.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核心，公理报告为空；叶模块。诸律皆近于定义；见证之关系项有限，其诸程之平衡证于每一步，并证其即所生之程。AI 所写；另两模型之读者对照本记录及其所在冷读诸陈述（见研究目录 READER）；无人类审计。

next_delta.en: A run made of the picks, so that occasions choosing different readings are realized on one course; and readings that vary along descent, so that how a reading arises, not only how it fares, is on the model.
next_delta.zh: 由诸择所成之一程，使择不同读法之诸场合实现于一程之上；及沿传承而变之读法，使读法如何生、不只如何存续，在模型之上。

correspondence.en: Reading (the AI's, from its knowledge): a reading inherited along descent and acted on is a heritable trait with its phenotype, the world acting by it its extended phenotype in the sense of niche construction (Odling-Smee, Laland and Feldman, 2003); the line read off a flow is a lineage of replicators, a self with no member kept.
correspondence.zh: 解读（AI 据其知识）：沿传承而继并依之而行之读法，即可遗传之性状及其表型，依之而行之世界即生态位构建意义上之延伸表型（Odling-Smee、Laland、Feldman，2003）；读自一流之系为复制者之谱系，一无成员恒存之自。

aliases: the line read off a flow

detail.en: Reuses the persisting line's laws (Flow.persists_never_overdraws, Flow.persisting_keeping_above_ending), with descent and the realization premise given by construction.
detail.zh: 复用存续之系之律（Flow.persists_never_overdraws、Flow.persisting_keeping_above_ending），传承与实现前提由构造给出。

output.en: A line persisting through late cohorts never overdrew; some strict order according with its choices puts keeping above ending on the pairs met.
output.zh: 存续至晚代之系从未透支；有一与其择相合之严格序，于同遇之对置守于终之上。

input.en: The line read off the course its readings generate.
input.zh: 读自其读法所生之程之系。

conditions.en: Balance, acting, dependence, gated renewal, coupled cohorts, no cycle shown; every occasion picks the carried reading.
conditions.zh: 平衡、唯活者给、活需支撑、门控之更新、诸代耦合、所示无环；每一场合皆择所携之读法。

detail.en: Reuses the generated course (ExchangeLaw.levels_succ, ExchangeLaw.totals_under) to show that a balanced flow following a law is its course, with no feasibility premise.
detail.zh: 复用所生之程（ExchangeLaw.levels_succ、ExchangeLaw.totals_under），以证依一律之平衡之流即其程，无须可行性前提。

input.en: A balanced flow following a law of what has stood.
input.zh: 依读已成者之律之平衡之流。

conditions.en: The law reads what has stood; the formations present and the start fixed.
conditions.zh: 律读已成者；在场之形成与起点固定。

detail.en: Its setting, the part acting by the act a significance gives, is met by construction where a line carries the reading.
detail.zh: 其设定，即部分依一意义所给之举而行，于系携此读法处由构造满足。

detail.en: Reach before a step, here lifted to lines with membership dated.
detail.zh: 步前之及，此处提升至系、成员身份有时日。

detail.en: Which readings persist on this model.
detail.zh: 在此模型上何种读法存续。

history.en: 9 November 2026, route (b)'s piece J2, on Ren's words of that day and of 8 November kept in sources (2026-11-09-route-b-ethics-forms.md, 2026-11-08-within-becoming-no-should.md): added. The join of route (b)'s four pieces found persisting a filter and the pool fixed across courses, and turned the next question from which order forms to which readings persist; this record answers part of it on a model of lines carrying inherited readings, on the course their acts generate.
history.zh: 2026年11月9日，路线 (b) 之 J2，依 Ren 当日及11月8日之言（存于 sources 的 2026-11-09-route-b-ethics-forms.md、2026-11-08-within-becoming-no-should.md）：新增。路线 (b) 四部分之接合发现存续为一筛、池在诸程间固定，遂把下一问从何种次序形成转为何种读法存续；本记录在携传承读法之系、于其行为所生之程之模型上回答其一部分。
